description: Co-op with AI buddies offline (Mike, 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17, T-NETWORKING-007): the original's one-player co-op from the offline Room's Campaign tab. B-1278 (2026-11-21): the staged agent is loaded with --launch-load-agent and --launch-offline-room opens the offline Room from CI through the Main Menu's own Combat Simulator entry, so the run needs neither Agent Select nor the Main Menu (their readiness waits need window focus a background game never has). The Room opens on the Campaign tab (--debug-room-tab campaign) and fires its own Start Match (--debug-auto-start-match) with Defection on Agent and the Partner choice at 2 simulants (--coop-ai-buddies 2). A fresh profile has no co-op completions, so the start clamps to one buddy (getMaxAiBuddies); the buddy spawns at the player, the mission plays until --debug-end-mission ends it at 40 s with every objective complete, and the results show.

input_sequence.comment: Boot (about 1:52 on base 9), the staged agent, the offline Room from CI, its Campaign Start Match and the co-op mission live and controllable, with one bounded Skip if the authored intro owns input. Script time waits here, so a slow boot shifts nothing.
The results, after --debug-end-mission ends the mission at 40 s.
Scripted clean exit 4 s (script time) after the results.

required_lines: BOOT: --launch-offline-room entered the offline Room agent='smoke' room_active=1
COOP\.AIBUDDIES: offline start stage=base:defection stageindex=0 difficulty=0 buddies=1 requested=2 max=1

required_sequences.name: agent-then-offline-room
patterns: BOOT: --launch-offline-room entered the offline Room agent='smoke' room_active=1

required_sequences.name: room-campaign-start-buddies-results
patterns: BOOT: --launch-offline-room entered the offline Room agent='smoke' room_active=1

forbidden_patterns: COOP\.AIBUDDIES: offline start (has no stage|: .* is not a campaign mission)
NET: weapon [0-9]+ .* has no session catalog id
NET: model [0-9]+ .* has no session catalog id
